video_subject: Cinematic romantic music reel about unexpected love arriving after heartbreak in a rainy European city at night
video_script: A lonely man walks through wet city streets after giving up on love. He notices a woman smiling softly in a warm cafe. Their eyes meet, but he hesitates. They walk together under city lights, sharing shy glances and quiet laughter. Close hands almost touch. He fears losing her. The final moments turn warmer as they finally hold hands and embrace, choosing love despite bad timing.
